items.reason: Eligibility requires 'pediatric high-grade glioma (WHO Grade 3 or 4, including DMG/DIPG)' with grade 4 allowed, no IDH requirement and glioblastoma never named; D31-B1 applies D30-R7 to such paediatric-labelled wording, and D31-B4 keeps cns5_terminology cns5 because the record cites 'the 5th edition of the WHO Classification'.

note: Outcome-neutral: Ages CHILD only (0-17), so the trial fails S4 (paediatric_only) before S5. gbm_population set by D31-B1/D30-R7; cns5_terminology stays cns5 by D31-B4 (WHO CNS5 cited). basket kept false: ATRT is also eligible, but D31-B15 applies only when GBM is named.
